rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: Lava's early activation can be validated against a later deployment.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: Use fresh 12F and Durin for the western interval. Credit neither 12F's dodge nor splash geometry; their damage before retaliation remains unverified.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: GALLUS² provides a durable unhealed western patrol finish.

changed_conflicting_assumptions.change: All dependent purchases require observed pioneer survival and successful income. A failed dependency is a survival or handoff failure.
changed_conflicting_assumptions.rejected: A conditional purchase supplies damage even when its income source died.

conditional_responsibilities.trigger: Patrol has not left eastern coverage at frame 3375.

conditional_responsibilities.responsibility: Remove its future attack credit and skip its retreat. Patrol death before exit remains mandatory.
Continue supported skills only when deployed, ready and needed, using the stated recovery intervals.
Keep the combat formation and defer clearance as one group. Subsequent clearance deployments retain actual cooldown and vacancy requirements.
Keep assigned device attackers deployed and wait for resolution without targeting civilians.
conditional_responsibilities.trigger: Devices or civilians remain after clearance formation is complete.

corridor_responsibilities.attack: Eastern Steward and Lava, followed by western Durin and 12F.
corridor_responsibilities.healing: Hibiscus supports Steward; Ansel supports Lava. Western finishers have no assigned healing.

corridor_responsibilities.clearance: Destroy surviving roadblocks after hostile clearance, then wait for safe civilian resolution.

corridor_responsibilities.protection: Intercept officers on all four approaches before they reach civilians held by roadblocks.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Final lower damage and eastern lower device

explicit_deadline_basis.deadlines: First column-5 runner interception is approximately 13.35, 18.35, 28.35 and 33.35 seconds. Last spawn is 211 seconds; patrol exit is approximately 133.97 seconds.

explicit_deadline_basis.economy: Initial 10 DP, natural +1/s, Fang self-cost reduction, observed Fang auto income and successful listed Vanilla activations. No refunds.
explicit_deadline_basis.limitation: Arithmetic does not establish survival, successful income or battle feasibility.

formation_structure.clearance: GALLUS² covers [1,6], 12F covers [6,6], Durin covers [6,2], and redeployed Steward facing LEFT covers [1,2].
formation_structure.final_ground: Midnight, Melantha, Cardigan and Beagle retain four independent interception duties. Steward supports upper damage; 12F supports lower damage using only the generic single-target model.
formation_structure.healing: Hibiscus covers both upper holds and eastern Steward. Ansel covers both lower holds and the lower caster tile within base range.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla hold the central approaches; Noir Corne and Friston-3 hold the outer approaches. Lancet-2 covers both lower holds until Ansel establishes sustained healing.
formation_structure.patrol: Steward [2,7] UP covers both eastern waits; Lava covers the lower eastern interval. After eastern departure, fresh Durin and 12F cover the final western wait and exit passage.

formation_transitions.handoff: Retire Lancet-2 only with both permanent medics deployed and lower holds alive; Lava takes the vacant [5,5] tile next frame group.
After observed patrol departure from eastern coverage, retire Steward and Lava before deploying both western finishers. This does not imply patrol death.
Funded, ordered Fang-to-Midnight replacement; pioneer income ends at the actual retreat.
Funded, ordered Vanilla-to-Melantha replacement after the intended final income.
Remove surviving western finishers only after observed patrol death; skip retreats for absent operators.
Return Steward after at least 70 actual seconds off field.
Return 12F after at least 70 actual seconds since western retreat or death.
After exhausted hostile spawns and zero living hostiles, retain 12F, vacate both medical tiles, and deploy two fresh clearance casters.
Complete western upper clearance only after Steward's actual 70-second redeployment cooldown.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Use only selected normal_low_star_catalog entries with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode=true; exclude mode-specific reserves and use supplied configurations.
Every DEPLOY uses integer [row,col], a listed direction, legal terrain and a vacant tile. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Never exceed eight deployed operators. Every action requires actual DP, deployment state, cooldown and skill readiness.
Same-frame replacements execute retreat before deployment; exact client equivalence is UNKNOWN.
Do not withdraw a ground hold without its fully funded replacement ready.
Do not credit refunds, unsupported talents, probabilistic effects, Cardigan healing, robot protection, splash geometry, RES debuffs or tactical targeting commands.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Officers may attack civilians within 1.2; civilian death deducts objective life.
Eastern shared healing and western attack time are acceptance conditions, not demonstrated improvements.
Patrol exit alive or any hostile leak invalidates the plan; later clearance cannot repair it.
Clearance begins only after hostile spawns are exhausted and every hostile, including the patrol, is dead.
WIN requires remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies, including unresolved civilians.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish four interceptors, activate Vanilla at readiness, and provide early lower healing without relying on robot protection talents.
Keep both pioneers and Friston-3 alive through the western patrol crossing; establish Ansel before buying patrol damage.
Maintain eastern patrol damage; Hibiscus's first boost protects the upper wait, and Ansel supports lower interception and Lava.
Retain eastern damage through the second upper wait. Shared Hibiscus healing and Steward survival are mandatory unresolved checks.
Transfer to fresh western attackers, perform funded pioneer handoffs, and require patrol death before exit.
Upgrade both outer holds, sustain the initial armored enemies, and return supported ranged damage after actual cooldowns.
Maintain all four holds through final runners and armor; use supported damage, DEF and healing skills.
Continue combat until all hostiles are dead, execute four-device clearance, resolve civilians, and evaluate the complete WIN predicate.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Support both lower opening holds with Lancet-2 before establishing permanent healing. Use four separate ground interceptors, protected eastern patrol damage, fresh western finishers, and explicit four-device clearance. Lava deploys once, eliminating the reported readiness conflict caused by her later redeployment.

unknown_dependencies.dependency: Opening single-target healing keeps Vanilla and Friston-3 alive through runner pressure and the patrol crossing.
Shared Hibiscus healing sustains eastern Steward through the second upper wait without a second ready boost.
Eastern damage leaves sufficiently little patrol HP for unhealed western finishers to kill it before retaliation or exit.
Final damage clears runner pairs and armor before blocking capacity overflows.
Client targeting, continuous timing and ordinary WALK navigation around active devices remain UNKNOWN.

revised_stage_understanding.CURRENT_MODEL: Neutral civilians are excluded from ordinary attacks and blocking; officer attacks can damage them. Device damage and safe civilian arrival require explicit clearance responsibilities.
revised_stage_understanding.GameData: Four ground approaches, one flying patrol, two civilians and four predefined roadblocks.
revised_stage_understanding.UNKNOWN: Client target priority and handoff timing, active-device ordinary WALK navigation, shared-healing survival and cumulative patrol damage.
revised_stage_understanding.validation: Read-only range queries, source SP calculations, cooldown arithmetic and conditional purchase ledger checked. No files changed and no simulation performed.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.acceptance: Opening units survive, intended income occurs, patrol dies before exit, every hostile route clears without leaks, and civilians resolve before the complete WIN predicate.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.limitation: Eastern Steward survival and sufficient patrol damage remain unverified. Static arithmetic and coverage do not establish a winning battle.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.thesis: Early lower healing and four continuous interception duties prevent the recorded survival-to-leak chain; single-deployment Lava and fresh western attackers provide patrol and clearance coverage without the prior SP conflict.

revised_tactical_requirements.execution: Conditional transfers are indivisible groups with actual-state gates. Failed survival or income does not authorize Python to alter tactics.
revised_tactical_requirements.legal_catalog: Only normal_low_star_catalog entries with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode=true; exclude mode-specific reserves.

changed_assumptions.conclusion: The same V13 timeline arrives later than the old m19.1 artifact; do not preserve timing merely because it previously appeared better.

prior_tactical_feedback.revision_requirement: Redesign opening survival, sustained healing, later interception and route coverage. Python will not choose operators, tiles, directions, skills, retreats or timing.
